subject: ipc

weeks.topic: Brainwave: how our brains help us learn
objectives: Know that the brain controls thinking and learning
Explore what helps our brains learn well

weeks.topic: Brainwave: personal goals and a growth mindset
objectives: Explore the IPC Personal Goals such as resilience and cooperation

Classify dinosaurs as herbivores or carnivores

objectives: Find out about Mary Anning's discoveries
Explain why her work was important

objectives: Place dinosaurs and early humans on a timeline

objectives: Compare and group rocks by their properties

objectives: Locate the Amazon, Nile, Yangtze and Thames on a map

objectives: Explain why early people settled near rivers
